verdict.rationale: The docs confirm a Workflows feature that fires on incident events, such as automatically publishing to the status page when an incident is updated. A related changelog entry describes two-way updates between tickets and incidents when either changes. The pack never describes Workflows as a condition-based engine or shows it handling reminders or field changes, so only a slice of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented condition/filter logic, automated reminders, automated incident field changes, breadth of workflow triggers and steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
